title: email decision
description: What to do with each draft. `subject` and `body` are the final text: send them as they stand, or rewrite from them. `edits` and `comments` say what the person changed and why, which is the part worth learning from.

action.description: send: this text, as it stands. revise: do not send, write it again from the comments and the note, and open a new round. discard: do not send at all

edits.description: what the person changed, in order; `from` empty means they added it, `to` empty means they cut it

comments.description: an instruction against a passage the person highlighted

note.description: an instruction or a reason for the draft as a whole

undecided.description: drafts the person did not rule on; nothing is sent for these
